description: Portal for the browser (RFC 0029): a statically composed WebAssembly client (Emscripten, wasm32) whose render core uses the WebGPU adapter over the browser's webgpu.h (the pinned Dawn release's emdawnwebgpu port). The engine runs in a worker on an OffscreenCanvas page (tools/web); tools/web/run_node.cjs is its Node lane. No legacy-stream renderer exists on WebGPU yet, so the shader API is the null provider.

dev.description: The browser client with function names kept for the browser's and Node's stacks
